comparisons.name: cap-light
comparisons.description: A regular and a mini pop-up button at rest: the cap's fill and hairlines, which a whole-crop score is too coarse to gate one by one, and the mini size, which no screenshot shows, Aqua.

pixels.note: middle stop of the measured accent gradient, the cap's fill at mid height (spec: pop-up-button, Cap gradient, 51%, measured as #3987fd in Aqua and #1764da in Dark Aqua)
cap's outer edge at mid height (spec: Cap right edge, measured, sRGB)
cap's top edge (spec: Cap top edge, measured, sRGB)
cap's bottom edge (spec: Cap bottom edge, measured, sRGB)
standard bezel fill (spec: push-button, Fill, measured)
the standard fill runs up to the cap: no separator between them (spec: Separator between title area and cap, none, measured)
mini: fill at mid height of a 15 pt box (inferred: no screenshot shows the mini size)
mini: the cap's fill, 12.5 pt wide, near mid height (inferred)
mini: the page just below the 15 pt box (inferred)

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the pop-up button, reached with Tab, Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the window background, measured on the Go to Folder field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB)
outermost quarter point of the ring: the band reaches 2.5 pt beyond the bezel's edge
page just outside the ring (spec: focus-ring, Geometry)
the cap keeps its accent

comparisons.name: main-window-light
comparisons.description: In a main window the cap loses the accent and Tab draws no focus ring, Aqua.

pixels.note: the cap is drawn like the rest of the bezel (spec: pop-up-button, States, inactive window: inferred from the measured disabled rendering)
no focus ring in a window that is not key (CONTRIBUTING, Window state)

pixels.note: the cap is drawn like the rest of the bezel (spec: pop-up-button, States, inactive window: inferred from the measured disabled rendering)
no focus ring in a window that is not key (CONTRIBUTING, Window state)

comparisons.name: image-light
comparisons.description: A button showing its item's image, a colour chip: the chip starts a point before the title's text and none of it is clipped, Aqua.

pixels.note: the chip's first half point, 8.5 pt from the box's edge: the fixture's own colour (spec: pop-up-button, image 8.5 pt from the edge, measured on the Highlight color button)
the half point before the chip: standard bezel fill (spec: push-button, Fill, measured)
the chip's second point, where the title's text box starts: the fixture's own colour
the chip's last whole point: it is 24 pt wide
after the chip, in the 5 pt before the text: standard bezel fill (spec: push-button, Fill, measured)

comparisons.name: contacts-label-light-arrows
comparisons.description: The label of a phone number on a Contacts card in edit mode, Aqua: a small pop-up button without a bezel, tinted through the button's two colour hooks; the place, size and colour of its arrows. The title is masked: text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms. No dark screenshot shows a card being edited.

comparisons.name: tint-light
comparisons.description: The two colour hooks of the button without a bezel, set to pure red and blue on the page: an enabled button without a bezel draws its title in the first; a disabled one and a button with a bezel keep their own colours, Aqua.

pixels.note: the chip of the enabled button without a bezel, drawn in the title's colour: the value of --mac-pop-up-button-borderless-color (the fixture's own red)
the tip of that button's upper arrow: the value of --mac-pop-up-button-borderless-arrow-color (the fixture's own blue)
the chip of the disabled button without a bezel: disabled control text, black at 25% over the white page (spec: pop-up-button, disabled title, measured), not the hook's red
the chip of the button with a bezel: control text, black at 85% over the white fill (spec: pop-up-button, title, measured), not the hook's red
